fi-he-194-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending section 1 of and Annex to the Act on Excise Tax on Liquid Fuels; Act amending the Act on Excise Tax on Electricity and Certain Fuels
fi-he-194-2025.t: amending the Annex to the Act on Excise Tax on Liquid Fuels and the Annex to the Act on Excise Tax on Electricity and Certain Fuels

fi-he-194-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the obligation of an audiovisual programme service provider to invest in audiovisual content
fi-he-194-2026.s: Based on the funding obligation for media services under AVMS Directive (EU) 2018/1808, HE is being prepared to fulfil this obligation in Finland.
fi-he-194-2026.t: As a law on the obligation of an audiovisual programme service provider to invest in audiovisual content

fi-he-195-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change Chapters 2 and 3 of the Health Insurance Act
fi-he-195-2024.s: The project aims to implement part of the necessary legislative changes to the government programme and to allocate additional funding (EUR 335 million of the State contribution) to the Kela payments under budget line 19.9.2023.
fi-he-195-2024.t: Act amending Chapters 2 and 3 of the Health Insurance Act

fi-he-195-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for laws amending the Environmental Protection Act and the Criminal Code
fi-he-195-2025.s: The Government's proposal implements the provisions on sanctions for the EU's F-gas regulation and the Ozone Regulation and the Emissions Portal Regulation.
fi-he-195-2025.t: Legislation amending the Environmental Protection Act and the Criminal Code

fi-he-195-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the adoption and entry into force of the Energy Charter Treaty
fi-he-195-2026.s: The proposal proposes that the Parliament of Finland adopt the agreement on the interpretation and application of the Energy Charter Treaty in Brussels on 18-22026 and the law transposing the provisions of the Treaty in its legislative field.
fi-he-195-2026.t: With a view to the adoption and entry into force of the Energy Charter Treaty

fi-he-196-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on the Minimum Tax of Large Groups
fi-he-196-2025.s: The purpose of the legislation is to supplement the provisions of the Minimum Tax Act to the extent that the implementation of the OECD Supplementary Administrative Interpretation Guidelines requires national legislation, including the possibility to seek a preliminary ruling from the Tax Administration.
fi-he-196-2025.t: Act amending the Law on the Minimum Tax of Large Groups

fi-he-196-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the Civil Service Act and other laws
fi-he-196-2026.s: According to Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's government programme, the government is developing the civil service system more appropriately, linking the service more clearly to the overall security approach.
fi-he-196-2026.t: Act amending the Civil Service Act and into other laws

fi-he-197-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on the Reference Instrument for Electricity Markets and Electricity Supply Contracts
fi-he-197-2024.s: The electricity market law would be reformed to allow for the use of a so-called "single invoice model" in the retail market, and the harmonisation of the general structures for transmission pricing of distribution networks to promote the introduction of an efficiency charge, the promotion of the introduction of market-based load management, and the definition of the accession management.
fi-he-197-2024.t: amending the Act on the Reference Instrument for Electricity Markets and Electricity Supply Contracts

fi-he-197-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for laws amending the Polytechnic Act and the Student Support Act
fi-he-197-2025.s: The task of the study group is to prepare the Board's proposal and regulations for the reform of the training of paramedics, midwives and nurses.
fi-he-197-2025.t: Act amending the Polytechnic Act and the Student Support Act

fi-he-197-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to repeal certain provisions of the Act on the transparency and disclosure of certain economic activities
fi-he-197-2026.s: The Government's proposal proposes that the provisions on reporting obligations laid down in the Act on the obligation to provide information and transparency in certain economic activities (19/2003) be repealed, which was based on Commission Directive 2006 / 111 / EC.
fi-he-197-2026.t: As a law repealing certain provisions of the Act on the transparency and disclosure of certain economic activities relating to certain undertakings

fi-he-198-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Cooperative Act
fi-he-198-2024.s: The first term of office of the working group, 11 December 2023-20 June 2024, produced a report on the increase of the threshold for the application of the code of conduct on the number of staff and the reduction of the duration of the negotiations for amendments to the form of a proposal from the Board of Directors.

fi-he-198-2025.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Act on the Processing of Personal Data of the Criminal Sanctions Agency and related laws
fi-he-198-2025.s: The project prepares legislative changes within the field of competence of the Ministry of Justice concerning government programme records on facilitating the exchange of information in improving prison security and preventing work-related exploitation and trafficking in human beings.
fi-he-198-2025.t: Act amending the Law on the Processing of Personal Data in the Criminal Sanctions Agency and related laws

fi-he-198-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Obligations Storage of Medicinal Products
fi-he-198-2026.s: The government's proposal implements Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's government programme records on the reform of the legislation on the compulsory storage of medicinal products.
fi-he-198-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the Obligation Storage of Medicinal Products

fi-he-199-2024.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland as a law amending the entry into force of the Foreign Law and the Act on the Temporary Amendment to it
fi-he-199-2024.s: The decision of the General Affairs Council of the European Union has extended temporary protection until 4.3.2026, and the granting of temporary protection to Ukrainian citizens and their family members after 4.3.2025 requires the amendment of the Foreign Law.
fi-he-199-2024.t: Act amending the entry into force of the Foreign Law and the Act temporarily amending it

fi-he-199-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Labour Contract Act and related laws
fi-he-199-2025.s: Implementation of government programme records amending the chronology of fixed-term contracts, the period of notice and the obligation to take back.
fi-he-199-2025.t: Act amending the Labour Contract Act and related laws

fi-he-199-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for a Act amending the Health Care Act and the Act on the Processing of Customer Data in Social and Health Care
fi-he-199-2026.s: The project aims to further and more widely explore the use of war data to anticipate service needs and the possibilities for use of artificial intelligence and automation in social and health care.
fi-he-199-2026.t: amending the Health Care Act and the Law on the Processing of Customer Data in Social and Health Care

fi-he-2-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Welfare Area and some other related laws
fi-he-2-2024.s: The proposal would implement the entries of Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's government programme in relation to changes in the governance of welfare areas.
fi-he-2-2024.t: amending the Act on the Welfare Area and certain other related laws

fi-he-2-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Public Procurement and Concessions and related laws
fi-he-2-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Law on Public Procurement and Concessions; Act amending the Law on Procurement and Concessions of entities operating in the water, energy, transport and postal services sectors; Act amending section 6b of the Criminal Registration Act; Act amending the Law on Water Management
fi-he-2-2026.t: Act amending the Act on Public Procurement and Concessions and related laws

fi-he-20-2025.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland for the adoption and implementation of amendments to the Annex to the SOLAS Convention, Protocol I to MARPOL and to the Annex to the Convention on Ballast Water, and for the amendment of section 12a of Chapter 6 of the Maritime Law and of the Passage Charges Act
fi-he-20-2025.s: The aim is to adopt and enforce the amendments to SOLAS, MARPOL and ballast water conventions adopted by the International Maritime Organisation, some of which fall within the scope of legislation and require the approval of the Parliament of Finland, and the amendment of the fairway charging law resulting from the EMW Regulation.
fi-he-20-2025.t: the adoption and entry into force of amendments to the Annex to the SOLAS Convention, to Protocol I to MARPOL and to the Annex to the ballast water Convention, and the laws amending section 12a of Chapter 6 of the Maritime Law and the fairway charging Act;

fi-he-20-2026.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland for the adoption and entry into force of amendments to the Convention on Road Signs and Signals, amendments to the European Agreement supplementing the Convention on Road Signs and Signals and amendments to the Protocol on Road Labelling to the European Agreement supplementing the Convention on Road Signs and Signals and amending the Road Traffic Act
fi-he-20-2026.s: The UNECE Working Party on Road Safety (WP.1) adopted the amendments to the Convention on Road Signs and Signals, Articles 1 to 13 of the European Agreement supplementing the Agreement and items 3 to 34 of the Annex and the Protocol on Road Labelling to the European Agreement at its 90th meeting in March 2025.
fi-he-20-2026.t: With a view to adopting and implementing amendments to the Convention on Road Signs and Signals, to the European Agreement supplementing the Convention on Road Signs and Signals and to the Protocol on Road Labelling to the European Agreement supplementing the Convention on Road Signs and Signals and to amending the Act on Road Transport

fi-he-200-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 47 of the Law on the Registration of Co-workers in Labour Protection and the Control of Labour Protection and Cooperative Work Protection at Work and the Investment Act
fi-he-200-2024.s: The proposal provides for the adoption of a law on the registration of co-workers in the field of health and safety at work, replacing the law on the register of workers (1039/2001) and amending two other laws. (section 47 of the Act (44/2006), Law (423/2016), Articles 1, 24 and 28.)
fi-he-200-2024.t: Act amending section 47 of the Law on the Registration of Co-workers in Labour Protection and the Control of Labour Protection and the Cooperative Labour Protection at Work and the Investment Act

fi-he-200-2025.f: Draft law of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on mediation in criminal matters and certain disputes and the Law on the Legal Service Agency
fi-he-200-2025.s: The aim is to prepare the changes to the structure of the Legal Service Office in order to achieve the productivity targets assigned to the Agency, in accordance with the Government Programme of Petteri Orpo, to transfer the mediation of criminal and dispute cases from the Ministry of Social Affairs and Health to the Ministry of Justice.
fi-he-200-2025.t: Act amending the Act on mediation in criminal matters and certain disputes and the Law on the Legal Service Agency

fi-he-200-2026.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland supplementing the Act on Social Welfare, Support for the Capacity of the Older Population and Amendment of the Act on Social and Health Services and the Act on Social and Health Care Customer Fees (HE 113/2025 vp)
fi-he-200-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Social Welfare Act; Act amending sections 16 and 20 of the Act on the Capacity of the Older Population and on the Social and Health Services of the Elderly; Act amending section 10e of the Act on social and health care charges
fi-he-200-2026.t: supplementing the Government's proposal to amend the Social Welfare Act, the Act on the promotion of the capacity of the elderly population and the Act on Social and Health Services for the Elderly and the Act on social and health care customer fees (HE 113/2025 vp)

fi-he-201-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the adoption and entry into force of an agreement on the exchange of classified information and mutual protection with Brazil
fi-he-201-2024.s: The proposal proposes that the Parliament of Finland approve the agreement on the exchange and mutual protection of classified information signed in July 2024 between the Republic of Finland and the Government of the Federative Republic of Brazil, as well as a law transposing the provisions of the Treaty which are governed by the law.
fi-he-201-2024.t: With a view to the adoption and entry into force of an agreement on the exchange of classified information and mutual protection with Brazil

fi-he-201-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the National Implementation of the Common Fisheries Policy of the European Union
fi-he-201-2025.s: The law is intended to be supplemented by provisions on the use of transferable access rights as collateral, to clarify the provisions on non-compliance with the obligation to use individual fishing quotas by operators, as the total utilisation rate of the Finnish fishing quota is low and to make certain technical clarifications to the law.
fi-he-201-2025.t: Act amending the Law on the National Implementation of the Common Fisheries Policy of the European Union

fi-he-201-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on interest subsidies for rental housing loans and housing loans and certain other laws
fi-he-201-2026.s: The project develops provisions on the selection of residents and the use of tenant housing for state-subsidised rental dwellings, as well as updates and regulation of government-subsidised housing legislation.
fi-he-201-2026.t: amending the Act on interest subsidies for rental housing loans and housing loans and certain other laws

fi-he-202-2024.f: The Government's proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the articles 11 and 46 of Chapter 1 of the Penal Code and to become related laws
fi-he-202-2024.s: Assessment of the legislative amendments required and prepared for the implementation of the Directive on the definition of offences and penalties relating to infringements of Union restrictive measures (hereinafter referred to as the Directive).
fi-he-202-2024.t: Act amending sections 11 and 46 of Chapter 1 of the Criminal Code and related laws

fi-he-202-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on the protection of geographical indications of craft and industrial products and related laws
fi-he-202-2025.s: The government's proposal implements the EU regulation on geographical indications for craft and industrial products, which proposes to give the competent authority the supervisory tasks set out in the regulation, and the government's proposal also proposes to establish a contact point for applications.
fi-he-202-2025.t: Law on the protection of geographical indications of craft and industrial products and related laws

fi-he-202-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on development policy investments
fi-he-202-2026.s: The project has prepared a draft of the Government's proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on investment in development policy.
fi-he-202-2026.t: As a law on investment in development policy

fi-he-203-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the law on Friendship Park
fi-he-203-2024.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the law on Friendship Park
fi-he-203-2024.t: Law amending the law on Friendship Park

fi-he-203-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 2 of the Natural Resources Agency Act and the Food and Natural Resources Act
fi-he-203-2025.s: The proposal proposes to amend the Natural Resources Agency Act and the Food and Natural Resources Statistics Act.
fi-he-203-2025.t: Act amending section 2 of the Natural Resources Agency Act and the Food and Natural Resources Act

fi-he-203-2026.f: The Board's proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on a limited company called Finnfund Oy and related laws
fi-he-203-2026.s: A new law on Finnfund Oy is proposed in the proposal. At the same time, the current law on the company "Industrial Cooperation Fund Oy" is proposed to be repealed.
fi-he-203-2026.t: Law on Finnfund Oy and related laws

fi-he-204-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the regulations on weapons offences
fi-he-204-2024.s: According to Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's programme of 16 June 2023, the minimum penalty for a serious firearm offence is increased from four months to two years of imprisonment in order to ensure that the general rule of imprisonment for which it is to be condemned is not complied with.
fi-he-204-2024.t: Amendment of the regulation on firearms

fi-he-204-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for patent law
fi-he-204-2025.s: The Working Party on the Review of Patent Law was set up on 25 May 2022. It has a mandate from 1 June 2022 to 31 May 2025 and is preparing its proposal for the form of a proposal from the Board of Directors, chaired by Ms Maija Lönnqvist, Minister for Industry of the Ministry of Employment and the Economy.

fi-he-204-2026.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland for the adoption and entry into force of the Partnership Agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the members of the African, Caribbean and Pacific Organisation of the other part
fi-he-204-2026.s: The proposal proposes that the Parliament of Finland adopt a partnership agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the members of the African, Caribbean and Pacific Organisation, of the other part.
fi-he-204-2026.t: with a view to the adoption and entry into force of the Partnership Agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the members of the African, Caribbean and Pacific Organisation of the other part

fi-he-205-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland as a law on protecting critical infrastructure in society and improving resilience to shocks and other laws
fi-he-205-2024.s: Legislative proposals: Act on the protection and resilience of critical infrastructure in society; Act amending section 19 of the Safety Investigation Act; Act amending the Act on the storage and disclosure of criminal records between Finland and other Member States of the European Union; Act amending sections 4a and 5 of the Criminal Registration Act
fi-he-205-2024.t: The law on protecting critical infrastructure in society and improving resilience and other laws

fi-he-205-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Code of Ammunition and Environmental Protection
fi-he-205-2026.s: The government programme aims to ensure the operation of the Finnish firing range and to promote the creation of new firing range. The Ministry of the Interior has set up a project to examine ways of securing the operation of the firing range and to prepare the necessary legislative changes.
fi-he-205-2026.t: Act amending the Code of Ammunition and the Law on Environmental Protection

fi-he-206-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 3 of the Dangerous Information Act
fi-he-206-2024.s: In the legislative project, the Act on Safety Information is amended to include a municipal health authority among the competent authorities to issue a hazard statement.
fi-he-206-2024.t: Act amending section 3 of the Dangerous Information Act

fi-he-206-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the law on Keva
fi-he-206-2026.s: The draft law would specify the provisions of the Spring Act concerning, inter alia, the term of office of the Keva delegates, the composition of the Keva Board of Directors and the eligibility requirements of the Keva management, as well as the investment and financial statements of Keva. The changes to the Act would enter into force at the beginning of 2028.
fi-he-206-2026.t: Amendment of the Law of Keva

fi-he-207-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on the tax credit for certain large investments aimed at climate neutral economy and on the amendment of section 3 of the Act on Innovation Finance Centre Business Finland and Business Finland
fi-he-207-2024.s: Legislative proposals: Act on the Tax Credit for certain large investments aimed at a climate neutral economy; Act amending section 3 of the Act on Innovation Finance Centre Business Finland and Business Finland
fi-he-207-2024.t: Act on the tax credit for certain large investments aimed at climate neutral economy and amending section 3 of the Act on Innovation Finance Centre Business Finland and Business Finland

fi-he-207-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on State Compensation and related laws
fi-he-207-2026.s: The proposed legislative changes aim to streamline the State's compensation activities and to clarify the information rights of the State Treasury and some of its partners, and to clarify the role of the State Treasury as representative of the State in the damages cases in which the State is a party.
fi-he-207-2026.t: Act amending the Act on State Compensation and related laws

fi-he-208-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation and law on borrowers and credit managers amending section 5 of Chapter 7 of the Securities Markets Act
fi-he-208-2024.s: Legislative proposals: Act on borrowers and credit managers; Act amending Chapter 15 of the Act on the Activities of Credit Institutions; Act on the amendment of the Financial Supervisory Act; Act amending sections 1 and 10 of the Act on Financial Supervisory Supervisory Charges
fi-he-208-2024.t: on the legal and legal framework for borrowers and credit managers amending section 5 of Chapter 7 of the Securities Markets Act

fi-he-208-2026.f: Draft laws of the Government amending the Act on the activities of credit institutions and related laws
fi-he-208-2026.s: The working group will prepare the necessary legislative changes, in particular as regards basic banking services, cash availability and availability, and customer protection and procedural regulation.
fi-he-208-2026.t: amending the Act on the activities of credit institutions and related laws

fi-he-209-2022.f: Government proposal to change the Waste Act
fi-he-209-2022.s: The proposal proposes: (1) keeping the exit limit for municipal waste management affiliated entities at 10% and (2) adding a transitional provision to the Waste Act to maintain the municipality's obligation to organise the management of municipal waste in a well-being area for a maximum period of 3 years.
fi-he-209-2022.t: Act on the amendment of the Waste Act

fi-he-209-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Academy of Finland
fi-he-209-2024.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Finnish Academy Act
fi-he-209-2024.t: Act amending the Act on the Academy of Finland

fi-he-209-2026.f: Draft Act of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending sections 10 and 20a of the Income Tax Act and related laws
fi-he-209-2026.s: The legislation on the taxation of investment funds will be amended to reflect the case law of the Court of Justice of the European Union, and changes will be made to the tax provisions of the Funds in order to enable the establishment of ELTIF funds.
fi-he-209-2026.t: Act amending sections 10 and 20a of the Income Tax Act and related laws

fi-he-21-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Promotion of Integration and related laws
fi-he-21-2024.s: The Government's proposal would amend the Act on the Promotion of Integration (681/2023), which will enter into force on 1 January 2025. Part of the changes will be based on the government programme and some will be more technical and particularly related to the coordination of labour service reform and the integration law.
fi-he-21-2024.t: amending the Act on the Promotion of Integration and related laws

fi-he-21-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending section 41 of the hunting law
fi-he-21-2025.s: The power to adopt a regulation under section 41 (5) of the Hunting Act would be amended to allow for more detailed provisions to be made by the Decree of the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry on the purpose of the derogation provided for in section 41a (3) of the Hunting Act, while section 41 (1) would also include a provision on matters to be taken into account in the authorisation review.
fi-he-21-2025.t: Act amending section 41 of the Hunting Act

fi-he-21-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend legislation on work-related exploitation
fi-he-21-2026.s: In order to prevent the exploitation of workers, penalties for abuse are significantly tightened.

fi-he-210-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the organisation of social and health care
fi-he-210-2024.s: The Ministry of Social Affairs and Health asks for your opinion on a proposal from the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland on the amendment of the Act on the organisation of social care and health care.
fi-he-210-2024.t: Act amending the Act on the organisation of social and health care

fi-he-210-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for laws amending the Investment Services Act and certain other laws
fi-he-210-2026.s: The project will prepare a government proposal for amendments to the Investment Services Act, which would repeal national regulation on the obligation for the investment firm to maintain a public insider register and the related disclosure obligation for the insider and complement the implementation of the MiFID II and SRD II Directives.
fi-he-210-2026.t: Act amending the Investment Services Act and certain other laws

fi-he-211-2026.f: Presentation by the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland of amendments to the provisions on the restructuring of tax legislation and certain other laws
fi-he-211-2026.s: The provisions on company restructuring will be made more flexible and updated on the basis of the completed evaluation memorandum.
fi-he-211-2026.t: amending the provisions on the restructuring of tax legislation and certain other laws

fi-he-212-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Basic Education Act
fi-he-212-2024.s: Amendment of the Basic Education Act to limit the use of mobile devices at school, increase the powers of the Regional Administrative Agencies in the area of school law, and increase the physical lifestyle to the educational objectives.
fi-he-212-2024.t: The law on the amendment of the Basic Education Act

fi-he-212-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Vocational Education and Training and related laws
fi-he-212-2026.s: The proposal proposes provisions for the organisation of secondary education in the event of disruption and exceptional circumstances, as well as further details on the legislation on matriculation examination, the law on upper secondary education, the law on vocational training and the law on experimenting with vocational training.
fi-he-212-2026.t: Act amending the Vocational Training Act and related laws

fi-he-213-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation and law on the safety of consumer services supplementing the EU General Regulation on product safety
fi-he-213-2024.s: The General Product Safety Regulation (EU) 2023 / 988 harmonises the legal framework for products covered by Union harmonisation legislation and for consumer products excluded from it.
fi-he-213-2024.t: legislation and law on the safety of consumer services to supplement the EU General Regulation on product safety;

fi-he-213-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Act on compulsory education and related laws
fi-he-213-2026.s: The Working Party set up by the Ministry of Education and Culture will prepare the necessary amendments to the compulsory education law, the education law for the preparation of qualifications, the basic education law, the vocational training law and the secondary school law, with a view to clarifying these laws in the light of the challenges identified in their implementation.
fi-he-213-2026.t: Act amending the compulsory education law and related laws

fi-he-214-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Border Guard Act
fi-he-214-2024.s: The aim of the project is to update the regulatory framework for barriers to the border zone, with a view to ensuring that the Geographic Institute is properly involved in the process of assessing compensation and decision-making.
fi-he-214-2024.t: Law on the amendment of the Border Guard Act

fi-he-214-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Forest Act
fi-he-214-2026.s: The task of the working group is to prepare the amendments to the Forest Act and the Government Regulation on the Sustainable Management and Use of Forests, the aim of which is to prepare a draft government proposal and a draft amendment to the Government Regulation on the Sustainable Management and Use of Forests.

fi-he-215-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on water management information reserve and related laws
fi-he-215-2026.s: The project aims to introduce a new law on water resources. The current legal basis for data on water management is incomplete and does not take into account, for example, the requirements for the protection of personal data.
fi-he-215-2026.t: Law on the aquatic information reserve and related laws

fi-he-216-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend sections 22 and 25 of the Income Information System Act and the positive Credit Information Register Act
fi-he-216-2024.s: The Act on the Income Information System would be amended to better meet the requirements of the General Data Protection Regulation as regards the accuracy of the information of the payer as well as the responsibilities of the data controller of the income registry unit and the rights of the data subject.
fi-he-216-2024.t: amending sections 22 and 25 of the Act on the Income Information System and the Law on the Positive Credit Information Register

fi-he-216-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Foreign Law and certain other laws
fi-he-216-2026.s: The project will implement legislative changes to the residence permit for growth entrepreneurs and entrepreneurs.
fi-he-216-2026.t: amending the Foreign Law and certain other laws

fi-he-217-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on Production Aid for Electricity from Renewable Energy Sources
fi-he-217-2024.s: The aim is to clarify the terminology of the market price for electricity in order to reflect the shift in trading in the electricity market from one hour to one quarter of an hour, and to allow electricity producers benefiting from the premium scheme to be excluded from the aid scheme if they so wish.
fi-he-217-2024.t: amending the Act on Production Aid for Electricity from Renewable Energy Sources

fi-he-217-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a regulation supplementing the Regulation of the Parliament of Finland and of the Council on the European Health Information Area
fi-he-217-2026.s: To introduce the necessary amendments to the Act on the processing of social and healthcare customer information (703/2023, the Customer Information Act) and related other laws to implement the Regulation on the European Health Information Area (EHIS), while making certain other necessary changes to those laws.
fi-he-217-2026.t: Regulation supplementing the Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the European Health Information Area

fi-he-218-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the redemption of immovable property and special rights and to introduce related laws
fi-he-218-2024.s: The criteria for reimbursement of the law on redemption will be renewed by strengthening the protection of property in accordance with the proposal of the expert and official working group (OM022: 00/2016), which was in progress at the Ministry of Justice (OM022: 00/2016).
fi-he-218-2024.t: amending the Act on the redemption of immovable property and special rights and related laws

fi-he-218-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to regulate the secondary use and sanctions of health data in the European Health Information Area Regulation
fi-he-218-2026.s: It proposes to introduce a new law supplementing the secondary use of electronic health data in the European Parliament and Council Regulation (EHDS) on the European Health Information Area in order to implement the amendments to national legislation resulting from the implementation of the Regulation and to introduce a penalty regulation.
fi-he-218-2026.t: Regulation supplementing the European Health Information Area Regulation on secondary use and penalties for health information

fi-he-219-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending Chapters 6 and 17 of the Criminal Code
fi-he-219-2024.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending Chapters 6 and 17 of the Criminal Code
fi-he-219-2024.t: Act amending Chapters 6 and 17 of the Criminal Code

fi-he-219-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the distribution of opioid overdose antidrugs and for a law amending the pharmaceutical law
fi-he-219-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act on the distribution of opioid overdose antidrugs; Act amending the Pharmaceutical Act
fi-he-219-2026.t: Act on the distribution of opioid overdose antidrugs and on the modification of the pharmaceutical law

fi-he-22-2025.f: Draft laws of the Government amending the Aviation Act, the Transport Services Act and the Cooperative Act to the Parliament of Finland
fi-he-22-2025.s: Amendments to the Aviation Act and the Transport Services Act are proposed to promote aviation safety, including the notification of the withdrawal of aviation passenger licences, non-interference with activities subject to authorisation and workers' breath tests, as well as further clarifications on flight barrier regulation.
fi-he-22-2025.t: Act amending the Aviation Act, the Transport Services Act and the Cooperative Act

fi-he-22-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on legislation implementing the Credit Institutions Directive
fi-he-22-2026.s: The project prepares a government proposal to the Parliament of Finland proposing amendments to the Law on Credit Institutions and the Act on Financial Supervision for the partial implementation of the CRD amending Directives (EU) 2024/1619 and the amending Directive (EU) 2024/2994 (EMIR3).
fi-he-22-2026.t: Legislation on the implementation of the Credit Institutions Directive

fi-he-220-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the law on crime victim fees
fi-he-220-2024.s: In accordance with the government programme, the project will examine the possibilities for increasing crime victims' fees. The evaluation will be used to prepare further preparations for the government's proposal to increase crime victims' contributions.
fi-he-220-2024.t: Act amending the Law on Criminal Victims Fee

fi-he-220-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland on the conformity of technical equipment intended for use as a law at work and amending certain related laws
fi-he-220-2026.s: In the case of machinery intended for use at work, the proposal would essentially implement the new EU machinery regulation (EU) 2023/1230, which requires legislation at national level, and aim at clarifying and updating the regulatory framework for technical equipment used at work.
fi-he-220-2026.t: on the conformity of technical equipment intended for use as a law at work and amending certain related laws

fi-he-221-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Tobacco Act
fi-he-221-2024.s: The purpose of the tobacco law is to provide for sales, characteristics, packaging, etc.

fi-he-221-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the formation of certain State-owned areas as Preservation Areas
fi-he-221-2026.s: The project proposes to amend the two laws on the formation of certain state-owned areas as protected areas, which have established 130 protected areas under the 1923 Nature Conservation Act.
fi-he-221-2026.t: Amendment of the Act on the formation of certain State-owned areas as Preservation Areas

fi-he-222-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on the enforcement of the provisions of the 1996 Protocol to the 1972 Convention on the Prevention of Pollution from Disposal of Waste and Other Substances in the Sea 2009 amendments
fi-he-222-2024.s: The purpose of the project was to allow the export of CO2 outside Finland for storage on the seabed.
fi-he-222-2024.t: amending the law transposing the provisions of the 1996 Protocol to the 1972 Convention on the Prevention of Pollution from the Dropping of Waste and Other Substances in the Sea of 2009

fi-he-222-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending section 17 of the Act on the Law on Trustees
fi-he-222-2026.s: To promote electronic access to the lobbyist and the representative representative, and to assess further possibilities for easing the impediment regulation of the trustee and the need for the guardian's permission in certain situations of renunciation, based on a previous government proposal (HE 69/2025 vp).
fi-he-222-2026.t: Amendment of section 17 of the Act on the Enforcement of Interests

fi-he-223-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the regulation on the scope of criminal law in Finland
fi-he-223-2026.s: The provisions of Chapter 1 on the territorial scope of criminal law are being reformed.
fi-he-223-2026.t: amending the scope of Finnish criminal law

fi-he-224-2020.s: The project proposes to introduce a law on the incorporation of commercial vaccine research services by the Institute of Health and Welfare.
fi-he-224-2020.t: Government proposal for a law on the incorporation of commercial vaccine research services of the Institute of Health and Welfare

fi-he-224-2026.f: Draft laws of the Board of Directors amending the Act on Election Financing
fi-he-224-2026.s: The motion proposes to amend the Election and Election Financing Act. The Election Act proposes changes in preparation for disturbances and changes in the appearance of voting tickets. The Election Finance Act proposes to extend the penalty payment procedure in the supervision.
fi-he-224-2026.t: Act amending the Act on Election Financing

fi-he-225-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for a Law on the Temporary Amendment of section 14 of the Lover Act and the Amendment of section 28 of the Gambling Act
fi-he-225-2026.s: The purpose of the legislative project is to prepare amendments to the lottery laws (1047/2001) and to the Gambling Act (10/2026) as regards the redemption of the money-fast-draw profit.
fi-he-225-2026.t: Temporary amendment of section 14 of the Lover Act and amendment of section 28 of the Gambling Act

fi-he-226-2026.f: Draft amending budget 2026 of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland
fi-he-226-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Draft amending budget 2026 III

fi-he-227-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on taxation of business income
fi-he-227-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Act on taxation of business income
fi-he-227-2026.t: Act amending the Act on taxation of business income

fi-he-228-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland as a law amending the Act on Social Assistance and repealing section 29 of the Act on the State Contribution of the Local Government to Basic Services
fi-he-228-2026.s: The Act on Income Support would be amended to allow the Social Insurance Institution to charge the municipality's contribution to the basic income allowance on a monthly basis. The reduction of the contribution would no longer be made for the municipality's basic services with a delay of two years. section 29 of the Act on State aid for basic services would be repealed.
fi-he-228-2026.t: Amendment of the Act on Social Assistance and repealing section 29 of the Act on the State Contribution to Basic Services of the Municipality

fi-he-229-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 2 of the Act on the financing of state research and development activities 2024-2030
fi-he-229-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending section 2 of the Law on the financing of state research and development activities from 2024 to 2030
fi-he-229-2026.t: Act amending section 2 of the Law on State funding for R & D in the period 2024-2030

fi-he-23-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 10 of the Law on State Export Guarantees
fi-he-23-2025.s: Increase the special risk-taking power of section 10 of the Export Guarantee Act from EUR 8 billion to EUR 12 billion, which does not increase the total amount of export-month liabilities (EUR 38 billion).
fi-he-23-2025.t: Act amending section 10 of the State Export Guarantees Act

fi-he-23-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law repealing section 7 of the Sport Act
fi-he-23-2026.s: I denna proposition föreslås det att betämmelsen om regionala idrottsråd i idrottslagen upphäs. Därmed behöver det inte inrätta något regionalt idrottsråd vid Tillsverket, har en annorlunda styrningsstruktur än de tidigare regionförvaltningsverken haft. Därmed behöver det inte inrätas något regionalt idrottsråd vid Tillstånd och tillsverket.
fi-he-23-2026.t: Law repealing section 7 of the Sport Act

fi-he-230-2020.f: Government proposal to amend the Health and Social Welfare Act; stand by issues
fi-he-230-2020.s: Amendments are proposed to the Health Act to entrust university hospitals with the task of directing preparedness planning in accordance with national uniform principles, and to create and share a health care situation picture. The provisions on the preparedness planning and situation picture of social care will be specified.
fi-he-230-2020.t: on the amendment of the Health and Social Welfare Act; emergency matters

fi-he-230-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the Supply Information Reserve and related laws
fi-he-230-2026.s: The project aims to implement a national public procurement information reserve covering public sector-wide public sector information on public procurement and purchases throughout the life cycle in a combined and comparable form, and to prepare the necessary legislative changes under the direction of the Ministry of Finance.
fi-he-230-2026.t: Act on the Supply Information Reserve and related laws

fi-he-231-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 6 of the State Pension Fund Act
fi-he-231-2026.s: The proposal proposes that the amount transferred from the Fund to the State budget in 2027 should be 67.5%, which would be 49.5% of the State's pension expenditure between 2028 and 2037, and that the amount transferred from 2038 onwards would be permanently 48% of the State's pension expenditure.
fi-he-231-2026.t: Amendment of section 6 of the State Pension Fund Act

fi-he-232-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on legislation on criminal intelligence in Customs
fi-he-232-2026.s: The proposal proposes to amend the law on criminal offences in Customs by creating criminal intelligence provisions for Customs which would allow the use of means of obtaining information at an earlier stage on a risk-based basis.

fi-he-233-2026.f: Government proposal for legislation on the organisation of early childhood education, basic education and free education in the Parliament of Finland in case of disruption
fi-he-233-2026.s: The proposal introduces provisions in the ECEC, the Basic Education Act, the Helsinki European School Act and the Free Cultural Work Act aimed at ensuring that legal activities continue as smoothly as possible in the event of disruption.
fi-he-233-2026.t: Legislation on the organisation of early childhood education, basic education and free education in case of disruption

fi-he-234-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend Chapter 3 and Chapter 8 of the Church Act and section 74 of the Orthodox Church Act
fi-he-234-2026.s: The project is intended to prepare amendments to the Act on the Law of the Church and the Act on Orthodox Church relating to the law on the shareholders' register of the estate.
fi-he-234-2026.t: Act amending Chapter 3 and Chapter 8 of the Church Act and section 74 of the Orthodox Act

fi-he-235-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending section 13 of the Act on National Literature, Education and Qualifications Registers, section 13 of the Law on Language Skills for General Government Staff and section 9 of the Act on the National Skills Information Reserve
fi-he-235-2026.s: The project implements the changes to the continental law, the need for which has arisen in the preparation of the accession of Åland to the national study and qualification registers, while taking into account the needs of the recent legislative changes and other data protection needs identified.
fi-he-235-2026.t: amending the Act on National Literature, Education and Qualifications, section 13 of the Law on Language Skills for General Government Staff and section 9 of the Act on the National Skills Information Reserve

fi-he-236-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the supervision and enforcement of the obligations of the EU Forest Destruction Regulation and related laws
fi-he-236-2026.s: The proposal is linked to the complementary national regulation required by EU Forest Destruction Regulation (EU) 2023/1115, which is the preparation of a new Forest Destruction Act, which would in particular provide for the imposition of a competent authority and its details of competence and for sanctions against the EU Forest Destruction Regulation.
fi-he-236-2026.t: Law on the supervision and enforcement of obligations under the EU Forest Destruction Regulation and related laws

fi-he-237-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending the Business Register Act, section 15 of the Business and Community Information Act and section 6 of the Patent and Registration Act
fi-he-237-2026.s: The project is preparing a proposal from the Board of Directors to implement the Second Directive on the digitisation of company law.
fi-he-237-2026.t: amending Articles 15 of the Business Registration Act, 15 of the Business and Community Information Act and 6 of the Patent and Registration Act

fi-he-238-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on certain periods of limitation and action under employment law
fi-he-238-2026.s: The project will assess questions relating to the time of action for working time plugins and, where appropriate, annual leave claims.
fi-he-238-2026.t: Legislation on certain periods of limitation and action in the field of labour law

fi-he-239-2026.f: Presentation by the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland of amendments to the legislation on certain tasks of the Centre for Employment, Development and Administration
fi-he-239-2026.s: The project prepares a government proposal to implement legislative changes related to some of the tasks of the RUGA, which is the result of a study carried out by the Ministry as an official, which has assessed the roles of the RUKA and the local employment services in particular and the division of tasks in promoting employment and recruitment.
fi-he-239-2026.t: Amendment of legislation on certain tasks of the Employment, Development and Management Centre

fi-he-24-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending section 1 of the Emissions Trading Act and the Energy Agency Act
fi-he-24-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Emissions Trading Act; Act amending section 1 of the Energy Agency Act
fi-he-24-2025.t: Amendment of section 1 of the Emissions Trading Act and the Energy Agency Act

fi-he-24-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for nuclear energy laws and related laws
fi-he-24-2026.s: The nuclear energy law will be fully reformed to take account of the changed environment, technological developments, changes in the energy market and the reform of other legislation and of the quar / EU regulation.
fi-he-24-2026.t: Nuclear energy law and related laws

fi-he-240-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend sections 11 and 23 of the Act on the emissions trading of fossil fuels and section 2 of the Act on sustainability criteria for certain fuels
fi-he-240-2026.s: It proposes to amend the Act on emissions trading in the distribution of fossil fuels and the Act on Sustainability.
fi-he-240-2026.t: Amendment of sections 11 and 23 of the Fossil Fuel Distribution Act and of section 2 of the Act on Sustainability Criteria for Certain Fuels

fi-he-241-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending section 65 of the Law on the implementation of the reform of social care and rescue services and the implementation of the relevant legislation
fi-he-241-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending section 65 of the Law on the implementation of the reform of the social, health and rescue services sector and the implementation of the relevant legislation
fi-he-241-2026.t: Amendment of section 65 of the Law on the implementation of the reform of the social, health and rescue services sector and the enforcement of the relevant legislation

fi-he-242-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the pharmaceutical law and related laws
fi-he-242-2026.s: The aim is to implement the records of Prime Minister Orpo's government programme on the provision and reception of international assistance for medicines and, among other things, to update hospital-pharmacy regulations in line with the welfare system.
fi-he-242-2026.t: Act amending the Medical Act and related laws

fi-he-243-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on legislation to harmonise pharmaceutical assessment activities
fi-he-243-2026.s: The project will continue to develop long-term pharmaceutical issues, with the aim of implementing Prime Minister Orpo's government programme record on the reform of the evaluation processes and criteria for the introduction of medicinal products for outpatient and inpatient care, with a view to ensuring that they are consistent regardless of the mode of administration of the medicine.
fi-he-243-2026.t: Legislation on the harmonisation of pharmaceutical assessment activities

fi-he-244-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland as laws amending the Agricultural Self-employed Pension Act and certain other laws
fi-he-244-2026.s: The aim is to amend the Act on the Pensions of the Self-employed and the Act on the Accident and Occupational Diseases of the Self-employed by the Farmers' Insurance Institution, as well as the grant holders of scientific research or artistic activities, who are entitled to a grant for the purposes of pension and accident protection.
fi-he-244-2026.t: Act amending the Agricultural Self-employed Pension Act and certain other laws

fi-he-245-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland as a law amending section 2 of the Self-employed Pension Act and the Pension Security Centre Act
fi-he-245-2026.s: The laws on the pension of the entrepreneur would be amended so that in future the entrepreneur could choose whether to base his pension contributions either on the current pension institution's estimate or on the taxable earnings of the business. The lower limit of the insurance obligation would be maintained at the present time and will continue to be based on the pension institution's assessment.
fi-he-245-2026.t: Act amending section 2 of the Self-employed Pension Act and the Pension Security Centre Act

fi-he-246-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the organisation of social and health care
fi-he-246-2026.s: The presentation proposes to amend the Social and Health Care Act, which would identify the tasks in which DigiFinland Oy could continue to act as a joint stakeholder in welfare areas and the state.
fi-he-246-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the organisation of social and health care

fi-he-247-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on access and related laws imposed by the Court
fi-he-247-2026.s: Enabling the application for a restraining order against a person causing repeated threats or disturbances to businesses.
fi-he-247-2026.t: Act on the Court's refusal of access and related laws

fi-he-248-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on the State Budget and related laws
fi-he-248-2026.s: The proposal proposes to amend the Law on the State Budget, the Law on the Treasury, the Act on the National Centre for Financial and Human Resources, the Act on Government Enterprises and the Law on the Forest Administration.
fi-he-248-2026.t: Act amending the Law on the State Budget and related laws

fi-he-249-2026.f: The Board of Directors' proposal for a tax credit for clean industry investments to be granted to the Parliament of Finland in 2027 and 2028 and amending section 3 of the Act on Innovation Financing Centre Business Finland and Business Finland
fi-he-249-2026.s: It is proposed to provide for a tax credit for investment provided for by the new State aid framework for the transition of the EU clean industry, following the tax credit provided for by the Law on the Tax Credit for some large investments in the climate-neutral economy (148/2025), which entered into force in the spring of 2025.
fi-he-249-2026.t: on the tax credit for investments in clean industry for 2027 and 2028 and amending section 3 of the Act on Innovation Finance Centre Business Finland and Business Finland

fi-he-25-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending section 30 of the Act on the System of Supervision of Banking and Payment Accounts, the Tax Procedure Act and the Own-initiative Tax Procedure
fi-he-25-2025.s: The aim and task of the project is to prepare a proposal from the government to increase the possibility of an account transaction survey to the banking and payment account control system, with the aim of enabling the government's proposal to be submitted to the Parliament of Finland during the spring session of 2025.
fi-he-25-2025.t: amending section 30 of the Act on the Control of Banking and Payment Accounts, the Tax Procedure Act and the Own-initiative Tax Procedure

fi-he-25-2026.f: Presentation by the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland of legislation on the reform of the organisation of the Criminal Sanctions Agency and the education system in the field of criminal sanctions
fi-he-25-2026.s: In September 2022, the Criminal Sanctions Agency carried out the first phase of a two-stage organisational reform, and the second and final phase of the reform is now being prepared for the organisation of tasks in the Criminal Sanctions Centres. In addition, the training system in the criminal sanctions field would be developed to meet the needs of the Criminal Sanctions Agency.
fi-he-25-2026.t: into legislation on the reform of the organisation of the Criminal Sanctions Agency and the training system in the field of criminal sanctions

fi-he-250-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for reform of credit institutions' legislation
fi-he-250-2026.s: The project will bring into force the reform of EU credit institution legislation in Finland, and will also modernise and update national credit institution legislation.

fi-he-251-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend and temporarily amend the Tax Accounting Act and to amend and amend the Income Tax Act
fi-he-251-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending and temporarily amending the Tax Accounting Act; Act amending and temporarily amending the Income Tax Act
fi-he-251-2026.t: amending and temporarily amending the Tax Accounting Act and the Income Tax Act

fi-he-252-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Customer Information System for Business Services
fi-he-252-2026.s: The proposal proposes that the Articles of the Act on the Customer Information System for Business Services be amended and repealed in part, which provide for certain reporting obligations for financial services. The purpose of the information is to be extended to the licence and to the Finnfund Oy is added to the business service providers.
fi-he-252-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the Customer Information System for Business Services

fi-he-253-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 37a of the Act on guarantees of origin for energy and the Law on sustainability criteria for certain fuels
fi-he-253-2026.s: Implement amendments to the Regulation on guarantees of origin of the Renewable Energy Directive (RED III).
fi-he-253-2026.t: Amendment of section 37a of the Act on guarantees of origin for energy and of the Act on sustainability criteria for certain fuels

fi-he-254-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Cooperative Act
fi-he-254-2026.s: The task of the working group is to implement the changes to the administrative representation of staff decided by the government at the mid-term meeting in the spring of 2025, to prepare its report in the form of a proposal from the Board, to be submitted to the Ministry for further preparation.

fi-he-255-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law to safeguard the secrecy of defence inventions
fi-he-255-2026.s: The law on inventions relevant to national defence (551/1967) contains provisions on the patenting of inventions which are relevant to national defence. The needs for amendment of the law have been assessed in the context of the overall reform of the patent law.
fi-he-255-2026.t: As a law to safeguard the secrecy of defence inventions

fi-he-256-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on the use of substances of human origin intended for use in human beings and related laws
fi-he-256-2026.s: Regulation (EU) 2024/1938 of the European Parliament and of the Council on quality and safety requirements for human substances intended for human consumption and repealing Directives 2002 / 98 / EC and 2004 / 23 / EC ("the Soho Regulation ') entered into force on 7 August 2024 and its application starts on 7 August 2027.
fi-he-256-2026.t: on the use of substances of human origin intended for use in human beings and related laws

fi-he-257-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Waste Act
fi-he-257-2026.s: The project is preparing amendments to the Waste Act (646/2011) to increase recycling and control of incineration in order to meet EU obligations, for example.
fi-he-257-2026.t: Act on the amendment of the Waste Act

fi-he-258-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the equipping of buildings with charging points and charging points for electric vehicles and with automation and control systems
fi-he-258-2026.s: The project amends the legislation on charging points for electric buildings, which is adapted to the requirements of the recast Directive on the energy efficiency of buildings.
fi-he-258-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the equipping of buildings with electrical vehicle charging points and charging point capabilities and automation and control systems

fi-he-259-2026.s: The project aims to prepare legislative changes to facilitate the status of overindebted enforcement debtors.
fi-he-259-2026.t: Facilitating the position of over-indebted debtors in enforcement

fi-he-26-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the transport of dangerous goods in the Defence Forces and Border Guard and related laws
fi-he-26-2025.s: The task of the group is to assess the legislation on the transport of dangerous goods by the Defence Forces and to prepare a proposal for regulatory reform.
fi-he-26-2025.t: Act on the transport of dangerous goods in the Defence Forces and the Border Guard and related laws

fi-he-26-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the law implementing the fine and related laws
fi-he-26-2026.s: The project is preparing a reform of the law on the enforcement of the fine.
fi-he-26-2026.t: Act amending the law implementing the fine and related laws

fi-he-260-2020.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland for the adoption of Council Decision (EU, Euratom) 2020/2053 on the system of the European Union's own resources
fi-he-260-2020.s: Legislative proposals: Council Decision (EU, Euratom) 2020/2053 on the system of own resources of the European Union and repealing Decision 2014 / 335 / EU, Euratom
fi-he-260-2020.t: adopting Council Decision (EU, Euratom) 2020/2053 on the system of the European Union's own resources

fi-he-260-2026.s: The proposal proposes to amend the car-fixing law so as to strengthen the vehicle-fixing system in addition to vehicles registered by the Transport and Communications Agency (Traficom) for vehicles registered by the Aland vehicle authority, and to clarify the powers of the authorities, appeal and time for processing applications.
fi-he-260-2026.t: Act amending the Car Restraint Act

fi-he-261-2026.s: Due to its high speed of adjustment, hydro power is a significant reserve source to balance the differences between consumption and production in different situations of the electricity system, the project is designed to allow for a derogation from the permit requirements for regulating the hydroelectric power plant, if necessary to balance the electricity system.
fi-he-261-2026.t: Temporary derogation from the permit provisions of the hydroelectric power plant to balance the electricity system

fi-he-262-2026.s: Review the timeliness of the monetary regulation of the minimum daily penalty.
fi-he-262-2026.t: Review of the amount of the minimum daily fine

fi-he-263-2026.s: On 5 April 2023, the European Commission presented a proposal for a Regulation on the transfer of criminal proceedings (COM (2023) 185 final), which aims to allow the transfer of criminal proceedings between Member States in order to investigate or prosecute a crime in the best-suited Member State.
fi-he-263-2026.t: Transfer of criminal proceedings (national legislation supplementing the EU Regulation)

fi-he-264-2026.s: In the second phase of the project, civil intelligence legislation will be reviewed in relation to intelligence powers to meet the requirements of a changed security and cyber environment.
fi-he-264-2026.t: Legislative project to revise Chapter 7 of the Civil Intelligence Act and the Police Personal Data Act, phase 2

fi-he-265-2026.s: The main objective of the project is to protect society and individuals from serious and organised crime by enhancing the exchange of information on organised crime and the administrative fight against organised crime, the task of which is to prepare key provisions for this set of issues.
fi-he-265-2026.t: Legislative project on legislation to combat organised crime and related legislation

fi-he-266-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending section 98a of the Act on Excise Tax on Liquid Fuels and the Excise Tax Act
fi-he-266-2026.t: Act amending section 99a of the Act on Excise Tax on Liquid Fuels and the Excise Tax Act

fi-he-267-2026.f: Government bill amending the Act on the Pension Fund of the Evangelis Lutheran Church
fi-he-267-2026.s: The proposal to amend the regulation on the management of the pension fund of the Evangelis Lutheran Church. The church government would no longer be the board of the pension fund, but the church assembly would elect a board of directors for the pension fund. The Board would appoint the head of the pension fund.
fi-he-267-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the Pension Fund of the Evangelis-Lutheran Church

fi-he-268-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation to amend the SORA provisions
fi-he-268-2026.s: The aim of the proposal is to clarify the provisions on the withdrawal of the right to study and drug testing of the Vocational Education and Training Act, the University Act and the Polytechnic Law, based on the development needs identified in the final report of the Socrates project, as set out by the Ministry of Education and Culture.
fi-he-268-2026.t: Legislative changes to the provisions of the Sora

fi-he-269-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to implement obligations arising from the International Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) and the EU Working Time Directive on inland waterway transport
fi-he-269-2026.s: The project implements the amendments made to the ILO International Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) guidelines in 2025, including the prevention of violence and harassment on board ships, and assesses the need for change and, if necessary, the changes to national legislation in the following sets: - insurance (rejection cases) required by the MLC and the maritime sector;
fi-he-269-2026.t: implementing obligations under the International Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) and the EU Directive on working time in inland waterway transport

fi-he-27-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 3 of the Cybersecurity Act and the Public Administration Information Management Act
fi-he-27-2025.s: The aim of the proposal is to supplement the national implementation of the NIS 2 and CER2 Directives on the application of the NIS 2 cyber security obligations to a critical actor.
fi-he-27-2025.t: Act amending section 3 of the Cybersecurity Act and the Public Administration Information Management Act

fi-he-27-2026.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland to supplement the Government's proposal amending and temporarily amending the Act on the Welfare Area (HE 189/2025 vp)
fi-he-27-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending and temporarily amending the Act on the Welfare Area
fi-he-27-2026.t: supplementing the Government proposal amending and temporarily amending the Act on the Welfare Area (HE 189/2025 vp)

fi-he-270-2026.f: Government proposal to amend the Act on the Control of Certain Artificial Intelligence Systems and to introduce certain other laws (implementation of Phase II of the Artificial Intelligence Regulation)
fi-he-270-2026.s: The Government's proposal would lay down national provisions for the implementation of the provisions of the EU Artificial Intelligence Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) which are to apply from 2 August 2026 (implementation of Phase II of the Artificial Intelligence Regulation).
fi-he-270-2026.t: amending the Act on the supervision of certain artificial intelligence systems and certain other laws (implementation of Phase II of the artificial intelligence regulation)

fi-he-271-2026.f: Government proposal for law on the monitoring of foreign investments and licensing procedures
fi-he-271-2026.s: The Ministry of Employment and the Economy has prepared, in cooperation with the Network of Public Authorities for Cross-Administrative Foreign Purchases (YKA), an evaluation memorandum (5.2.2025) on the need for the renewal of the Law on the Monitoring of Foreign Purchases (172/2012). The working group for the preparation of HE has started work in March 2025.
fi-he-271-2026.t: Law on the monitoring of foreign investment and authorisation procedures

fi-he-272-2026.f: Government proposal for a law amending the Measuring Instruments Act and certain other laws and repealing the Regulation of the Consumer Affairs Council
fi-he-272-2026.s: The proposal proposes that the negotiation committees provided for in the measuring instruments laws (707/2011) and in certain other laws be abolished.
fi-he-272-2026.t: Repeal of the Regulation amending the Measuring Instruments Act and certain other laws and the Consumer Affairs Council

fi-he-273-2026.f: Government proposal to amend section 3 of the Drugs Act and the Act on Electronic Prescriptions
fi-he-273-2026.t: Act amending section 3 of the Drugs Act and the Act on Electronic Prescriptions

fi-he-274-2026.f: Draft legislation of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending sections 15 and 20 of the Act on Health Care Professionals, the Law on Social Welfare Professionals and the Act on Authorisation and Control
fi-he-274-2026.s: Under the programme of the Government of Petteri Orpo, the overall reform of social and health professionals' legislation will be carried out as part of the Good Work Programme. The reform will be carried out in a way that links professional rights only to the necessary and proportionate conditions for customer and patient safety.
fi-he-274-2026.t: amending sections 15 and 20 of the Health Care Professionals Act, the Health Care Professionals Act and the Authorisation and Control Agency Act

fi-he-275-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on the implementation of certain United Nations sanctions

fi-he-276-2026.f: Government proposal for the adoption and entry into force of the family and spouse agreement between Finland and Australia
fi-he-276-2026.s: The government proposal for the agreement is due to be submitted in autumn 2026.
fi-he-276-2026.t: Adoption and entry into force of the family and spouse agreement between Finland and Australia

fi-he-277-2026.s: The project is designed to prepare the main provisions on police criminal investigations and thus to improve police access to information on internal security threats related to police tasks.
fi-he-277-2026.t: Legislative project on police criminal intelligence legislation and related legislation, Phase 2

fi-he-278-2026.s: The project is preparing the proposed amendments to the Civil Protection Code in the framework of the "Exploration of the Reform of the Rescue Act" project (SMDro 2019- 2078) and other studies, taking into account the entries of Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's government programme.
fi-he-278-2026.t: The second phase of the rescue law reform project

fi-he-279-2026.s: The project is designed to prepare the main provisions on criminal intelligence of the Border Guard, thereby improving the ability of the Border Guard to better inform the Border Guard about internal security threats associated with the tasks of the Border Guard.
fi-he-279-2026.t: Legislative project on border guard criminal intelligence legislation (Phase 2)

fi-he-28-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on extradition between Finland and other Member States of the European Union and the Act on extradition between Finland and other Nordic countries
fi-he-28-2025.s: The aim is to present a government proposal amending the Act on extradition between Finland and the other Member States of the European Union.
fi-he-28-2025.t: amending the Act on extradition between Finland and other Member States of the European Union and the Act on extradition between Finland and other Nordic countries

fi-he-28-2026.f: Draft act of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending the title of Chapter 9 and section 61 of the Customs Act
fi-he-28-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the title of Chapter 9 and section 61 of the Customs Code
fi-he-28-2026.t: Act amending the title of Chapter 9 and section 61 of the Customs Code

fi-he-280-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Fisheries Act
fi-he-280-2026.s: The proposal introduces a new section 7a in the Fisheries Act, which provides that the general fishing rights referred to in section 7 of the Act should not be used for commercial fishing, and proposes that the Act be amended to remove the exception allowing the sale of a small quantity of fish to leisure fishermen.

fi-he-281-2026.s: The project aims to implement the amendments made in 2024 by Directive (EU) 2024/3101 of the EU Directive on ship emissions, while proposing certain amendments to the Annex to the International Convention on the Prevention of Pollution from Ships (MARPOL).
fi-he-281-2026.t: Amendments to the Marine Environmental Protection Act; implementation of the Ship Emissions Directive

fi-he-282-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the Central Data Register
fi-he-282-2026.s: The government's proposal proposes to introduce a requirement for data centres to register to maintain the industry's situation picture, which would provide authorities with a more comprehensive and forward-looking picture of the investment in the data centre.

fi-he-283-2026.s: Opinions were requested on the draft opinion from 9 March to 4 May 2026.

fi-he-284-2026.f: Government proposal on information reserves under the Environmental Protection Act, the Law on the Organisation of Water Management and the Law on the Management of the Sea and the Nature Conservation Act
fi-he-284-2026.s: The project examines the need for changes to the provisions of the Information System for the protection of the environment and nature protection in relation to the overall reform of the government's programme-based data protection legislation.
fi-he-284-2026.t: on information reserves under the Environmental Protection Act, the Water Management Act and the Nature Conservation Act

fi-he-285-2026.f: Government proposal for national implementation of the Urban Waste Water Directive
fi-he-285-2026.s: Preparation of amendments to national legislation required by the recast Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive; environmental protection law, water management law, health protection law, infectious disease law, and possibly civil engineering law, circular economy law and energy efficiency law.
fi-he-285-2026.t: National implementation of the Urban Waste Water Directive

fi-he-286-2026.s: The project will make a proposal to introduce a provision on the revision of permit regulations into the Environmental Protection Act (527/2014).
fi-he-286-2026.t: Restoration of the procedure for the revision of the permit provisions of the Environmental Protection Act

fi-he-287-2026.f: Government proposal to implement the amendment of the Air Quality Directive
fi-he-287-2026.s: Implementation of the amendment to Directive (EU) 2024/2881 of the European Parliament and of the Council on ambient air quality and improvement of air quality (2008 / 50 / EC) by amending the Environmental Protection Act and the Air Quality Regulation. The deadline for national implementation expires on 10 December 2026.
fi-he-287-2026.t: on the implementation of the amendment of the Air Quality Directive

fi-he-288-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 4 of the Act on the restriction of the use of hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment
fi-he-288-2026.s: The proposal proposes to amend section 4 of the RoHS Act (387/2013) in order to implement the OSOA Directive (EU 2025/2456) and to move to the reference procedure in order to ensure that certain technical annexes and amendments to the RoHS Directive (EU 2011 / 65) enter into force directly without national action.
fi-he-288-2026.t: amending section 4 of the Act on the restriction of the use of hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment

fi-he-289-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on the Government
fi-he-289-2026.s: The proposal proposes a limited derogation from the general provisions on the date of public access to documents under the Government Act on the Government Council for certain documents held by ministries in connection with government negotiations.
fi-he-289-2026.t: Act amending the Law on the Government

fi-he-29-2023.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the temporary travel document of the European Union and related laws
fi-he-29-2023.s: The Government's proposal brings into force at national level Council Directive (EU) 2019 / 997, the Directive lays down the conditions and procedural rules under which non-represented citizens can obtain an EU temporary travel document (EU TMA).
fi-he-29-2023.t: Law on the European Union's temporary travel document and related laws

fi-he-29-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Foreign Law
fi-he-29-2024.s: The project prepares a government proposal for the implementation of certain amendments to the Alien Law that the EU Directive on Definitions (2011 / 95 / EU) allows and complements the national implementation of the Directive.

fi-he-29-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending Chapter 5a of the Police Act and for certain other laws
fi-he-29-2025.s: The project is essentially concerned with the revision of civil intelligence law and the law on the exchange of information between the police department of protection
fi-he-29-2025.t: Law on the modification of Chapter 5a of the Police Act and on certain other laws

fi-he-29-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on the taxation of real estate and income from offshore wind
fi-he-29-2026.s: The project prepares legislative changes to ensure property and income taxation in the Finnish Economic Zone.
fi-he-29-2026.t: Legislation on property and income taxation for offshore wind power

fi-he-290-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Export Control of Dual-Use Products
